name: What is the process for replacing a skylight?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for replacing a skylight?

acceptedAnswer.text: The skylight replacement process typically begins with removing the old skylight and any damaged flashing or trim. We then inspect the roof opening for structural integrity and make any necessary repairs. A new skylight unit is installed, followed by new flashing and sealants to ensure a watertight seal. Finally, any interior trim is reinstalled or replaced. We handle all aspects, from initial assessment to final cleanup in the Emeryville and Dublin service areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves removing the old unit, inspecting the opening, installing the new skylight with fresh flashing and sealants, and finishing the interior trim.
